what: data hashes (xxh3-64, seed 0, over the postcard bytes of the three definition sets; tools/data_reference.py) of the template of map 4 with and without mean_ref (Grok GF-1)
encoding: Trait { id, sigma_ref, mean_ref, exclusive, includes }: mean_ref only when present, as postcard writes Some(f64): the byte 0x01, then the f64 as 8 bytes little endian; when absent nothing (skip_serializing_if), so every map without it hashes as before
demography: data/calibration/demography.json of the worktree (the template has none of its own)
build: take tests/golden/map4_template/genetics/genome_map.json, insert "mean_ref": <value> right after "sigma_ref" in the named trait entries; calibration tests/golden/map4_template/calibration/genetics.json; life course data data/calibration/demography.json

bounds.rule: bound = fold from +0.0, in the order of A, of max over d in {0, 1, 2} of |c * (d - d_ref)|; then bound + |mean_ref| when present (absent: nothing added); bound / sigma_ref finite, and <= 2^1022 for a trait with a phenotype row
